newsitem.title: BURMA: Burma seizes 100 kg of amphetamine base.
newsitem.headline: Burma seizes 100 kg of amphetamine base.

text.p: Burmese military authorities said on Tuesday they had seized 100 kg (221 lb) of amphetamine base smuggled from China.
The seizure was made from a vehicle that had entered the country at the Burma-China border, a brief government statement said.
Thai narcotic experts in Bangkok said the seized chemicals could be used to make about one million amphetamine tablets.
Over the past six months, between 12 and 18 million amphetamine tablets had been smuggled into Thailand by traffickers from Burma, the Thai Office Of Narcotics Control Board said recently.
